games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Which word means a home where bees live and make honey?
rounds.explanation: Bees build a hive and store their honey inside it. A broom, a ladder and a wardrobe are things at home, not animal homes.

rounds.prompt: In “Different Kinds of Homes”, what are adobe houses built from?
rounds.explanation: The text says people build adobe houses from mud and dry grass, and that the thick walls keep them cool.

rounds.prompt: Which of these things would you find in a bathroom?
rounds.explanation: A bathroom has a sink and a toilet for washing. A sofa belongs in the living room, a nest is a bird's home, and a ladder is not a bathroom thing.

rounds.prompt: The lamp is ____ the two books.
rounds.explanation: Between means in the middle of two things, so the lamp has one book on each side of it.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence is written correctly?
choices: There is two chairs in the kitchen.
There are two chairs in the kitchen.
There am two chairs in the kitchen.
There be two chairs in the kitchen.
rounds.answer: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
rounds.explanation: Two chairs is more than one thing, so the sentence needs there are.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence talks about the future in the right way?
choices: I will to sweep the floor.
rounds.explanation: After will we use the plain verb, with no to and no -ing, and will always comes before the verb.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: Which three animal homes does the poem name, and which animal lives in each one?
choices: A nest is for a bird, a hive is for a bee, and a hole is for a rabbit.
A set of rooms that is part of a big building.
Grandma Hana is coming, and she will stay for one whole week.
rounds.answer: A nest is for a bird, a hive is for a bee, and a hole is for a rabbit.
rounds.explanation: Lines one, two and three each name one animal and its home, so read them in order to collect all three pairs.

rounds.prompt: The text says many people in cities live in flats. What exactly is a flat?
choices: They are built from mud and dry grass, and the thick mud walls keep the rooms cool.
Amal made her bed and put her clean clothes in the wardrobe. Idris picked up his toys from under the bed and put them in the toy box.
A set of rooms that is part of a big building.
rounds.answer: A set of rooms that is part of a big building.
rounds.explanation: The text gives the meaning of the word flat right after it uses it.

rounds.prompt: In hot, wet places, why do people build their houses high on stilts?
choices: A tree house, with walls, a small roof and a tiny window.
So that the air can blow underneath the house.
They are built from mud and dry grass, and the thick mud walls keep the rooms cool.
rounds.answer: So that the air can blow underneath the house.
rounds.explanation: The text gives the reason straight after the fact, using the word so, which signals why something is done.

rounds.prompt: Theo says his tree house is like a small house in a tree. Which three parts make it like a house?
choices: It has walls, a roof and a small window.
So that the air can blow underneath the house.
A place where a family helps each other, not just walls and a roof.
rounds.answer: It has walls, a roof and a small window.
rounds.explanation: Theo lists the three parts together, and they are the same parts that any house has.

rounds.prompt: In the bedroom, what job did Amal do and what job did Idris do?
choices: Theo's father built it, and it is in their garden.
Any two real jobs named in full sentences, such as “At home, I set the table.” and “At home, I sweep the floor.”
Amal made her bed and put her clean clothes in the wardrobe. Idris picked up his toys from under the bed and put them in the toy box.
rounds.answer: Amal made her bed and put her clean clothes in the wardrobe. Idris picked up his toys from under the bed and put them in the toy box.
rounds.explanation: Both jobs are in the paragraph that begins “First, they went to the bedroom.”, one after the other.

rounds.prompt: What did Grandma Hana say a home really is?
choices: She felt very glad. Any reason grounded in the story, such as the house looked lovely, Grandma was happy, or the family worked as a team.
A place where a family helps each other, not just walls and a roof.
rounds.answer: A place where a family helps each other, not just walls and a roof.
rounds.explanation: Grandma Hana says this after she hugs the children, and it is the lesson of the whole story.
